titulo: Quiz — Say it before you need it
introPt: A traveller enters a shop, moves through a crowd and leaves properly.

dialogo.pt: Excuse me, can I ask you something?

perguntas.pergunta: When do you say buongiorno in a small shop?
opcoes: On the way in, before looking at anything
perguntas.explica: The greeting is the opening move of the transaction.
You announce the move; you do not apologise for existing.

opcoes: Opens a question or repairs a bump
perguntas.explica: English collapses both into excuse me; Italian keeps them apart.

perguntas.pergunta: Should you say ciao to a waiter you just met?
opcoes: Yes, it is the normal hello
Better not — it is informal and mutual
perguntas.explica: Buongiorno and arrivederci are the safe pair with anyone behind a counter.

perguntas.pergunta: When does buonasera take over from buongiorno?
perguntas.explica: The changeover is fuzzy and regional; an early buonasera offends nobody.
